notes.title: Launch Day Patch 1.1.0
notes.content:
Greetings fellow tax payers!

Today marks the launch of Angus and the Gates of Chaos, and with it the first of the (hopefully) few patches for the game. Good luck, and happy adventuring!


[h2][b]Fixes in Version 1.1.0[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an Issue with one of the game's secret achievements that prevented the true ending from being reached
[*] General Stability Fixes
[/list]
